summary_markdown:
Someone reported a data anomaly observed on the live site: upon refreshing the page, the displayed values were double the expected amount. Opening a new tab resolved the discrepancy.

[me] confirmed that the issue was observed on production and noted that while fixes might have been deployed to production, they may not yet be available on staging.
decisions: The reported data summation bug needs further investigation.
action_items: If the issue recurs, [p1] should attempt to screenshot or document it for better reproduction.
